title: The high temperature vanished
hints: `low` is always right and `high` is always `None`. What does `max` see that `min` didn't? Print `list(present)` right before the `max` call.
`present` is a generator expression: a one-shot iterator. `min` reads it to the end, so `max` gets an empty stream and falls back to its default.
Make `present` a list instead of a generator: swap the round brackets for square ones, `[r for r in readings if r is not None]`.
